emails.subject: Interim Monitoring Visit Scheduling - Protocol PH-123, Site 045
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

I hope you are having a good week.

I am writing to coordinate the next interim monitoring visit (IMV) for the PH-123 study. I would like to propose the following dates for a 2-day on-site visit:

- November 14-15
- November 20-21
- November 28-29

Please let me know which of these dates works best for you and the site staff.

To help streamline the on-site activities, we are exploring the possibility of conducting some source data verification remotely ahead of the visit. Could you please let me know if City General Hospital provides temporary, read-only access to your EMR system for monitors? If so, what is the process to request access? I am happy to complete any required training or sign necessary confidentiality agreements.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

Sarah Miller
Clinical Research Associate
PharmaCorp
sarah.miller@pharmacorp.com

emails.subject: Re: Interim Monitoring Visit Scheduling - Protocol PH-123, Site 045
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for reaching out. The dates of November 20-21 would work well for us. We will reserve a room for you on those days.

Regarding remote EMR access, our institution does allow this. The process requires you to complete our online IT security and HIPAA training module and sign our institutional Remote Access Agreement. I have attached the agreement form for you to review and sign. I will send a separate email with the link to the training module.

Please send me the list of patient charts you wish to review at your earliest convenience so we can prepare them.

Best,

Maria Garcia
Study Coordinator
City General Hospital
m.garcia@cghospital.org

emails.subject: Re: Interim Monitoring Visit Scheduling - Protocol PH-123, Site 045
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

That's great news. I will book my travel for November 20-21. Thank you for reserving a room.

I have received the Remote Access Agreement and will review, sign, and return it by the end of the day. I will also be on the lookout for the training module link.

I will send the list of subjects for review by this Friday. Thanks for all your help in coordinating this.

Best regards,

Sarah Miller
Clinical Research Associate
PharmaCorp
sarah.miller@pharmacorp.com

description: An email exchange to coordinate the scheduling and logistics for an upcoming interim monitoring visit, including a request for remote access to the site's electronic medical records.
